name: The Clone
description: Human cloning. The Islamic world. Two young people, two different cultures, two different beliefs. An impossible love story that not even time could erase. During a trip to Morocco, Lucas has a forbidden romance with Jade. He returns to Brazil after the death of his twin brother Diogo. A close family friend, scientist Albieri uses this situation to produce the first human clone using cells taken from Lucas. Twenty years later, Jade, Lucas and his clone form an odd love triangle.

credits_cast.character: Lucas Ferraz / Diogo Ferraz / Leo (Leandro Edvaldo Moura da Silva)
credits_cast.name: Murilo Benício
